decisions.reason: As a publicly presented flagship tied to the firm's sustainability direction, management is heavily committed and would attribute any slow uptake to seasonal or adoption delays.
A multi-model foldable container line with its own page represents substantial tooling investment and visible commitment, central to returnable logistics packaging.
A stackable crate line with several models fits the core portfolio, and its mold investments argue for persistence despite only brief website mention.
Rackable pallets are a core offering, and the invested multi-model tooling makes withdrawal after one year unlikely.
The spill-retention pallet line has its own page and several models, so it is visibly committed even though it is somewhat peripheral to transport packaging.
A single pallet variant with its own page and sunk mold costs would likely be kept, with weak results attributed to the short time on the market.
